title: Conical Defects in JT Gravity from BF Theory: Quantization, Fusion, and Weighted Moduli Spaces
summary: We construct a gauge-invariant BF representative of a conical defect in Jackiw--Teitelboim gravity, with its elliptic direction fixed by the reconstruction of the gravitational variables. In the gravitational sector, the BF observable reproduces the metric defect insertion and its distributional curvature source, and fixes the holonomy around the defect to an elliptic conjugacy class. For a single defect on the disk, the position integral combines with the residual \(\mathrm{PSL}(2,\mathbb R)\) quotient, leaving a fixed elliptic sector.
